places.name: Ration office / private flat
places.story: Crates and the public counter below; a comfortable private room and telephone upstairs.

places.name: Market store

greeting.npc: This used to be the meeting hall. We moved the beds in when the trucks stopped coming. The ration office is the two-storey building behind us.
The shelves are bare, but the stockroom is not. We sell what we can and save the rest for the ward.
